description: Defines an abstract class 'ValueDescriptor' used for describing and managing property values within the MigraDoc document object model, including methods for creating, getting, setting, and null-checking values, as well as factory method for creating specific descriptor types based on property info.

classes.name: ValueDescriptor
classes.description: Base class for all value descriptor classes, providing mechanisms to create, get, set, and nullify property values, and factory method for descriptor creation based on property info.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates an instance of the described value type.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the value from a document object.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to set a value in a document object.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Abstract method to set the value in a document object to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the value in a document object is null.

methods.name: CreateValueDescriptor
methods.description: Factory method to create specific value descriptor instances based on property info and attributes.
